neighbours.label: the token ' were' as a plural past auxiliary or copula after a plural subject, as against ' was' after a singular subject in the same sentences
fire: After the storm, hundreds of homes were left without power.
In the old report, several bridges were described as unsafe.
By noon, all the tickets were sold at the box office.
During the flood, many roads were closed for a week.
Last spring, three new schools were opened in the district.
At the auction, dozens of paintings were bought by one collector.
Before the match, the players were told to stay calm.
In the end, most of the letters were never delivered.
quiet: After the storm, one large home was left without power.
In the old report, the main bridge was described as unsafe.
By noon, the last ticket was sold at the box office.
During the flood, the main road was closed for a week.
Last spring, a new school was opened in the district.
At the auction, one painting was bought by a collector.
Before the match, the captain was told to stay calm.
In the end, the final letter was never delivered.
